response.overview: Maria, a successful woman, does not emphasize religious matters and tends to collect various types of statues despite her husband's disapproval. Maria feels she is still young and dislikes being advised by Nora, her best friend, about prayer and modest clothing. For Maria, death is still far away. She also rejects the advice of Irfan, her husband. Irfan does not want to dispute it because he enjoys the luxuries that Maria provides. Their wedding anniversary is planned by Maria to Bali, even though Irfan often suggests they visit the Holy Land instead. However, for Maria, they are still young and will visit it when they are older. In Bali, they have chosen an attractive resort that symbolizes the traditional characteristics of Balinese society. They are welcomed warmly with flower garlands and traditional Balinese music and dance. The chalet provided for them is exclusive and specially designed for newlyweds who often come for their honeymoon.
response.title: Aku Belum Mahu Mati
